chosen_titles.rationale: Legislative Law (LEG) houses the Regulation of Lobbying Act codified as Article 1-A (Lobbying Act), the canonical lobbying-disclosure regime with per-section leaves.
Regulation of Lobbying Act 1040/81 (RLA) is a parallel single-page codification of the same Article 1-A act, retained as a support/fallback path.

notes: NY 2025 vintage available on Justia; year-prefixed URLs emitted by the patched helper. leg/ is canonical (section-leaf children); rla/ is a single monolithic page (lossy stub) included as support. exc/ (Executive Law) deliberately excluded as a cross-reference stub, consistent with the NY 2010 canary.
